overlayBoxes.title: Bank Statements Cover Six Weeks, Not the Six Months Required
overlayBoxes.details: Bank statements provided cover only about six weeks for an £875,000 transaction by an overseas client. Firm policy requires a minimum of six months' statements for high-value transactions exceeding £500,000 or for overseas clients.
